## Expand, then collect {#two-single-brackets}

Expand each bracket with its own multiplier. Then collect like terms.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$2(x+4)+3(x-2)$

::: {.fragment}

[Distribute $2$ and $+3$.]{.annotation}

$=2x+8+3x-6$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Collect the terms in $x$, then the constants.]{.annotation}

$=5x+2$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$2(x+4)-3(x-2)$

What is multiplying the second bracket? Expand on paper.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

The second multiplier is $-3$.

$=2x+8-3x+6$

$=-x+14$

:::
